risk_if_not_implemented: Without Clock Synchronization, security may be bolted on rather than designed in, resulting in structural weaknesses that are costly to remediate and easy to exploit. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Investigative / Evidentiary Capability (R-IR-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Space Weather (NT-9); Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Time Stamps
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to configure Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) to use an authoritative time source to generate time stamps for event logs and security-relevant telemetry.
compensating_control_1.justification: Time Stamps (MON-11) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Clock Synchronization (SEA-30) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a Security Incident Event Manager (SIEM), or similar automated tool, to support the centralized collection of event logs and security-relevant telemetry.
compensating_control_2.justification: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry (MON-05) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Clock Synchronization (SEA-30) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
